module: Node "Custom Vehicle Lua" (category `repeat_p_duration`, tags lua/vlua/command/code). Runs Lua code in the vehicle VM with `veh:queueLuaCommand(func)`. Input pins: `vehId` (default: player), `func` (string, code to run). Output: `flow`, `vehId` (hidden).
notes: Executed every frame while the flow is active.
The code is executed as is: this is arbitrary execution, so no untrusted source.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

_onDeserialized.desc: Migration of old projects: moves `data.func` to a hardcoded pin `func`.

work.desc: Sends `func` to the vehicle and copies `vehId` to the output.
